learning_order:
**Solo default: Enhancement** (both Forever guides call it the fastest leveling spec).

- **1-10:** Rockbiter Weapon, Earth Shock, Lightning Shield, Earthbind Totem, Healing Wave. Pull with Lightning Bolt, Earth Shock, melee. Skip Stoneclaw Totem.
- **10-20:** Flame Shock, Strength of Earth Totem, Searing Totem (quest), Fire Nova (12), Cure Poison. Purge and Tremor Totem are optional. Flametongue Weapon only if you use a shield/caster setup.
- **20:** Ghost Wolf, Call of the Elements and Totemic Recall are the key buys. Frost Shock and Lesser Healing Wave are optional; Frostbrand Weapon can be skipped.
- **22-28:** Totemic Call (projection) is optional (very mana-expensive). Skip Frost/Fire Resistance Totems and Far Sight. Buy Magma Totem and Mana Spring Totem at 26.
- **30:** Windfury Weapon (switch to a slow two-hander), Reincarnation, Astral Recall. Skip Nature Resistance Totem; Grounding Totem is PvP.
- **32-40:** Lightning Shield, Healing Wave, Earth/Flame Shock and totem ranks. Windfury Totem is a party buff only (you don't benefit while using Windfury Weapon). Skip Sentry and Windwall Totem. Mail at 40.
- **40-60:** keep shocks, Lightning Shield, Searing/Magma, Strength of Earth, Windfury Weapon and Healing Wave current. After 30, Rockbiter ranks are for tanking only.
- **Elemental:** add Chain Lightning, Lava Burst (talent ranks 40/50/60) and keep Lightning Bolt current.
- **Resto/healer:** Lesser Healing Wave, Chain Heal, Healing Stream, Mana Tide and Riptide ranks (talent ranks are cheap).

**Money tips**
- Safe skips: all Resistance Totems, Far Sight, Sentry Totem, Windwall Totem, Stoneclaw Totem, Frostbrand Weapon.
- Higher Ancestral Spirit ranks only matter in groups.
- Call of the Ancestors / Call of the Spirits are convenience only; buy when gold is spare.
- Talent-gated ranks (Lava Burst, Riptide, Mana Tide) are cheap; buy them if you have the talent.
- Save for Apprentice Riding at 40; Ghost Wolf covers travel until then.
- Keep Ankhs for Reincarnation; Water Walking/Breathing need reagents.
disagreements: Classic guide (Warcraft Tavern Classic) suggests dropping Lightning Bolt from 10-29 for mana and saving Earth Shock for interrupts; Forever guides (Warcraft Tavern Forever) pull with Lightning Bolt and use Earth Shock as filler.

Method.gg: use Rockbiter Weapon through level 30, then Windfury on a two-hander; Warcraft Tavern Forever lists Windfury Weapon or Rockbiter as the maintained imbue (Rockbiter mainly for tanking threat).
Warcraft Tavern Classic says learn everything 1-20; no Forever guide gives a rank-skipping list, so rank advice here follows general practice.
Elemental viability: Warcraft Tavern Forever says Elemental balance is in flux and mana-heavy; both Forever guides recommend Enhancement for solo leveling.
forever_differences: Weapon imbues last 60 min (was 5) and stack with stones/oils (Blizzard deep dive).
Fire Nova Totem removed; new Fire Nova spell erupts from your current fire totem and can be reused (Blizzard deep dive); threat goes to you (Method.gg).
Windfury Totem and Flametongue Totem are party buffs, no longer weapon enchants; you don't benefit while using the matching weapon imbue (Blizzard deep dive).
Persistent buff totems last 5 min, totem GCD 1.0 s, resistance totems apply raid-wide (Blizzard deep dive).

New Call of the Elements (20), Totemic Recall (20), Totemic Projection (22) and extra totem sets; Blizzard listed Call of the Spirits at 30 and Call of the Ancestors at 40, the trainer list has Ancestors at 30 and Spirits at 40.
Lightning Bolt rank 4+ casts in 2.5 s and Chain Lightning in 2.0 s (Blizzard deep dive).
Lava Burst, Riptide, Stormstrike, Mana Tide are talent spells; Stormstrike moved to 16-point tier (Blizzard deep dive).
Astral Recall is a second hearthstone with 15 min cooldown (Warcraft Tavern Forever).
Lightning Bolt/Healing Wave rank 1, Searing/Stoneskin/Healing Stream Totem rank 1 are not on the trainer list (granted baseline or via class quests per Warcraft Tavern Forever).
open_questions: Trainer list names spell 437009 'Totemic Call' at 22; Blizzard calls the level-22 spell 'Totemic Projection' (moves totems, 25% base mana). Assumed same spell.
Blizzard noted a beta bug where Totemic Recall did not refund mana; unclear if fixed at launch.
Flametongue Weapon value for Enhancement dual wield in Forever is not covered by the guides read.
